ideas.pitch: An offline-first graph intelligence and risk detection platform tailored for monitoring suspicious micro-transactions, peer-to-peer lending irregularities, and vendor payouts within a large campus ecosystem.
ideas.title: CampusGraph AML: Financial Risk Intelligence for University Ecosystems
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence and explainable models similar to Bito, appealing directly to judges looking for robust enterprise-grade AI architecture applied locally.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform designed to track unauthorized land usage, construction changes, and environmental degradation across university or regional municipal boundaries.
ideas.title: GeoNex-MUJ: Satellite Land and Infrastructure Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of GeoNex-ATLAS by solving real-world GIS compliance problems with practical computer vision pipelines that judges can immediately visualize.

ideas.pitch: An offline-friendly nutritional intelligence platform that scans campus dining hall menus, predicts daily micronutrient intake, and dynamically generates personalized meal plans for student athletes and residents.
ideas.title: NutriCampus AI: Real-time Mess Nutrition and Wellness Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the winning formula of E-Foodiee by targeting an immediate, relatable campus pain point with rapid AI API integration.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting engine that utilizes Poisson regression and rolling backtests on historical campus security logs and lighting data to predict localized safety incidents and optimize patrol routes.
ideas.title: IncidentCast AI: Campus Safety and Security Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the rigorous statistical forecasting methodology of the Apart Research winning incident forecaster to an impactful institutional safety use case.

ideas.pitch: A high-speed video intelligence platform that ingests unstructured recorded lecture archives, transcribes and indexes semantic concepts, and generates searchable, time-stamped knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: LectureLibrAI: Multimodal Video Intelligence for Academic Archives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the LibrAI winning formula by turning unstructured educational media into instantly queryable data, a major win for university-hosted hackathons.
